messages.content: What is the freezing point point of water at a pressure of 10 kPa?

function.name: thermodynamics_calculate_boiling_point

message.content:
At 10 kPa (≈0.1 atm) water freezes at a temperature slightly below 0 °C.  
According to the water phase diagram, the solid–liquid equilibrium line at this pressure lies at roughly **–2 °C** (about –1.9 °C to –2.1 °C depending on the source).  

So, the freezing point of water at 10 kPa is approximately **–2 °C**.
